note: Mock data modeled on a real weekly Friday status-report workflow across 10 teams (6 internal, 4 vendor). ground_truth_* fields are author-labeled for Milestone 5 evaluation only and must NOT be passed to the classifier in Milestone 2.

updates.update_text: Legal has finalized copy and distributed it to Web Platform, Mobile, and Dealer Systems teams. Teams will begin updating websites and communications to reflect the new language this week.
updates.self_reported_rationale: Need to keep track of each site and validate the language has been implemented as required.
updates.ground_truth_note: Handoff just occurred with a week of runway across multiple sites and no stated tracking/validation process yet.

updates.update_text: Received finalized CCPA copy from Legal on 10/22. Have not started implementation yet — our release train is locked for the Q4 security patch going out 10/25. Will begin CCPA text updates immediately after, targeting 10/30.
updates.self_reported_rationale: Very little buffer between the security patch release and our own due date.
updates.ground_truth_note: Security patch release is legitimately superseding CCPA work; one-day buffer before due date.

updates.update_text: Awaiting confirmation from our dealer portal vendor (BrightPath) on their release calendar before we can push CCPA copy live to dealer-facing sites. No response since our request on 10/15.
updates.self_reported_rationale: Assuming BrightPath responds early next week, we can still make the date.
updates.ground_truth_note: Vendor unresponsive for 9+ days on the critical path; see HND-520 for the vendor-side reason. Self-reported risk likely understated.

updates.update_text: Finalized and distributed CCPA copy on 10/20 as planned. No further action needed from Legal at this time; monitoring downstream team confirmations.
updates.self_reported_rationale: Our deliverable is complete and on time.
updates.ground_truth_note: Legal's own deliverable is done on schedule.

updates.update_text: Cutover rehearsal scheduled for 10/29 has slipped to 11/03 due to a staffing shortage on Acme's side. This is the second reschedule in three weeks.
updates.self_reported_rationale: Still expect to hit the 11/07 cutover date.
updates.ground_truth_note: Two reschedules in three weeks is a trend, not a one-off; four days of buffer left before the due date. See also HND-700.

updates.initiative: Data Center Cloud Migration - Security Review
updates.self_reported_rationale: Last update (10/17) stated: "On track for October."
updates.ground_truth_note: No response to the weekly request at all, one week before the due date.

updates.update_text: Creative assets are on track and in final legal review. No blockers.
updates.ground_truth_note: Clean status, three weeks of runway. Contrast with HND-95 from the same team this same week.

updates.update_text: Localization vendor flagged a translation discrepancy in 3 of 12 markets; fix is in progress and expected resolved by 10/28. Not a threat to the launch date at this time.
updates.self_reported_rationale: Small, scoped issue with a clear resolution date well ahead of launch.
updates.ground_truth_note: Proactively surfaced and well-managed; a good false-positive test for over-flagging classifiers.

updates.update_text: Team is heads-down on an unrelated emergency: a critical defect in the November firmware release that Honda escalated Monday. All other requests, including the dealer portal release calendar, are paused until that's resolved — no ETA yet.
updates.self_reported_rationale: Firmware defect takes priority over all other current work.
updates.ground_truth_note: Directly explains why HND-146c (Dealer Systems Integration) is stalled — same vendor, cross-team dependency.

updates.update_text: Same status as last week: waiting on Data Privacy & Legal Ops to confirm the final consent taxonomy before we can finalize mapping. Due date is tomorrow.
updates.self_reported_rationale: Dependency is with Legal, not on our side.
updates.ground_truth_note: Due date is one day out with an unresolved external dependency; self-reported Medium likely understates the actual risk. See HND-89.

updates.update_text: Consent taxonomy is under legal review; this week's competing priority was the CCPA website copy (HND-146/HND-201) plus an unplanned request from Compliance on an EU DSAR audit. Taxonomy review pushed to next week.
updates.self_reported_rationale: Low risk to our own due date of 10/31; just a scheduling delay.
updates.ground_truth_note: Self-rated Low from Legal's own vantage point, but this delay is directly blocking HND-88, which is due tomorrow. Classic self-report-vs-program-reality gap.

updates.update_text: On track. QA sign-off expected 10/24 end of day, release 10/25 as planned.
updates.ground_truth_note: This is the release that's freezing HND-146b for the same team — legitimate priority, on track for its own date.

updates.update_text: Certificate renewal with our identity vendor is on track; tested in staging 10/22, production deploy scheduled 10/25.
updates.ground_truth_note: On track as reported; contrast with HND-611 from the same team, same week.

updates.update_text: New emergency: a partner integration broke in production this morning due to an upstream API change from the partner. Pulled two engineers off the SSO cert work to triage. SSO deploy is likely still fine for 10/25 but now has zero buffer.
updates.self_reported_rationale: Contained so far, but resourcing is thin.
updates.ground_truth_note: Same team as HND-610; an unplanned incident is now competing with a still-on-track ticket, worth flagging even though HND-610 itself looks clean.

updates.update_text: Dealer onboarding for 4 new regional dealers completed ahead of schedule. Closing this ticket.
updates.ground_truth_note: Completed early; same team as the blocked HND-146c this week.

updates.update_text: Raised the repeated cutover slippage (see HND-310) to our Acme account exec and to our own VP of Infrastructure on 10/21. No response from either as of today.
updates.self_reported_rationale: Cutover date is at real risk without executive intervention on either side.
updates.ground_truth_note: Risk explicitly raised to leadership on both sides three days ago with no response — the escalation itself is stalled, not just the technical work.

updates.update_text: New ask came in from the CMO's office this morning to fast-track a competitor-response campaign for launch next week, ahead of the previously planned holiday campaign work (HND-402). Team is re-sequencing priorities now.
updates.self_reported_rationale: Confident we can deliver both, but sequencing isn't finalized yet.
updates.ground_truth_note: Unplanned executive ask superseding previously planned work from the same team this same week — direct example of the emergency-reprioritization pattern.
